IMT Manesar is one of the densest auto and engineering belts in the country — the plants and their component vendors keep up constant work that needs site offices, gate security cabins, and supervisor rooms. SAMAN builds those cabins. We manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and run them across to Manesar in 3 to 5 days, ready to set on your plinth. A single guard cabin at a Sector-8 plot or a multi-room contractor office on an IMT plant project — call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we’ll work out the spec and a price.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

Search “porta cabin in Manesar” and you mostly get IndiaMART supplier cards — prices from around ₹38,000 for a small unit up past ₹2 lakh, with little to tell sellers apart. The cards rarely state the steel grade, the panel thickness, or how the cabin’s fixed down. For an IMT plant supplier or a Sector-8 contractor running a job for years, that’s the detail that decides whether the cabin holds up.

We make the porta cabins, so when you call you reach the people who build them. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • A frame in IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections — welded, primed, powder-coated, then anchor-bolted to your plinth so it stays put.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls — insulation that handles a Manesar summer and the NCR winter both.
  • A colour-coated GI roof, pitched for the monsoon, with a false ceiling under it.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points and tube-light provision.

The paperwork is real. ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS is Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, and we already supply across the Gurgaon belt that Manesar sits in, so this is familiar ground for us.

Delivery runs ₹3,000 standard, transit to Manesar is 3–5 days, and returns are 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Manesar

Manesar’s auto-and-engineering belt decides what cabin a buyer needs:

IMT Manesar (Sectors 1–8, PIN 122051) — the planned industrial township that defines the town: large auto plants, component and engineering vendors, and a constant churn of plant projects. Steady demand for gate security cabins and supervisor offices, and on plant expansions, multi-room contractor blocks and worker accommodation, often several cabins at once.

The Sector 7 and adjoining belt (PIN 122052) — more vendor and engineering units, plus the institutional pockets. Site offices, security posts, and small two-room offices.

The Kasan and Naharpur side — the village-edge industrial plots and the newer units spreading out from IMT. Compact cabins mostly: a guard room here, a supervisor office there.

Beyond the plants there’s the construction side: the Dwarka Expressway and Western Peripheral (KMP) corridors, warehouse parks, and the new commercial and housing development along NH-48. All of it runs on porta cabins for the site office and the gate.

Because we dispatch from Greater Noida across the NCR to Manesar, it’s a short 3–5 day run from our factory. Across the wider NCR belt, the same factory-direct network handles our porta cabin in Bhiwadi and porta cabin in Panipat deliveries too.

What You’re Actually Getting — Specifications

Built for the NCR climate: hot summers, a real winter, a monsoon.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded and zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel as standard — insulation that works both ways across Manesar’s hot-and-cold year. Cement board for a tougher skin on a long plant posting.

Roof: colour-coated GI sheet, pitched for drainage, false ceiling underneath. Turbo ventilators for open plant plots with no shade.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate, or laminate for a sit-down office.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, louvre or sliding windows, fixed glazing on request. All fitted at the factory.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Sizes off the shelf: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, 10×40 (the 40 ft block). Odd size? We’ll build to it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, a full multi-room block, with an attached toilet or a pantry if you need one.

What People in Manesar Use Them For

  • Gate security cabins at IMT plant and vendor plot entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices on auto-plant expansion projects
  • Portable office cabins and supervisor rooms at IMT units
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the larger plant and project sites
  • Site stores for tools and material at project yards
  • Site-management offices on expressway and warehouse construction

Customising It to Your Site

Most orders aren’t the bare standard cabin. Common changes:

  • Custom size and multi-room layouts
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for a summer office — common for IMT supplier offices
  • Extra wall and roof insulation for the NCR winter
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for open, shadeless plant plots
  • Internal partitions, extra doors or windows
  • Plumbing run for an attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where the load numbers allow

Tell us the plot and the use; we’ll confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Manesar

On the marketplaces you’ll see Manesar prices from around ₹38,000 for a small basic unit up past ₹2 lakh, with per-sq-ft rates around ₹870 and up. The spread is wide because no two cabins are the same. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room is the floor, a 10×40 block the ceiling.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a tougher build.
  3. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  4. Climate kit — ventilator, false ceiling, extra insulation, AC provision.
  5. Quantity — order five or more and the per-unit price comes down.

For a real number on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Manesar Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it across the NCR to Manesar — a short haul on the same belt as the porta cabins we already supply across Gurgaon. Three to five days in transit. When it lands, we set it on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block takes about a day to settle. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard — ask for a combined rate if you’re taking several. One thing to be clear about: we don’t have a yard or branch in Manesar. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked straight to your plot.

Looking After It

A SAMAN cabin needs very little. Wash the dust off the panels now and then, keep the roof drains clear before the monsoon, and check the door and window fittings once a year. The powder-coated MS frame and GI roof take years of plant-site use with that light attention — no annual repainting, no special upkeep.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Manesar

Do you deliver porta cabins to IMT Manesar?

Yes — IMT Manesar (all sectors), the Kasan and Naharpur belt, and construction sites across Manesar. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory and takes 3–5 days, since Manesar is a short run on the Gurgaon belt. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

What does a porta cabin cost in Manesar?

Marketplace listings run from about ₹38,000 for a small basic unit to over ₹2 lakh, with per-sq-ft rates around ₹870 — but the real number depends on size, panel type, fit-out and quantity. We quote against your exact spec rather than publish a fixed price. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

What sizes and layouts can I get?

Stock sizes run 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, and 10×40 ft, in single-room, two-room, or full multi-room layouts, with an attached toilet or pantry on request. Need an odd size? We build to it.

Can you supply multiple cabins for an IMT plant project?

Yes. We supply contractors and project managers, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send the project scope and we’ll confirm what we can supply and by when.

How long from order to delivery in Manesar?

Transit is 3–5 days once the cabin’s built, since Manesar is a short run on the Gurgaon belt. Production time depends on the configuration and your place in the queue — standard sizes move quicker. We’ll give you a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Manesar

Need a porta cabin in Manesar — for an IMT plant plot, a vendor site, or an expressway construction project? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or drop your requirement in the enquiry form. We’ll come back with the right spec for your plot, a delivery date, and a firm price. You can also browse our porta cabin offices built for industrial sites for sizes and configurations.
